g.text: Shows the main software/domain classes and relationships for
a factory with multiple monitored machines. It documents why
the design uses one ESP32 sensor node per machine and how
telemetry and alerts move through MQTT, gateway, cloud, and dashboard.
one ESP32 sensor node per machine.
Sensors are wired locally to the ESP32,
while machine data is sent upstream using
Multiplicity: exactly one, one or more, zero or more
Aggregation: factory contains machines as assets
Composition: machine owns its monitoring module; module owns its local parts
Primary telemetry path from ESP32 node to gateway/cloud
Return path for alert/command messages back to ESP32
